acceptance.given: A Replay Result reports success for a replay that contains a Probe.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain replay result independently recomputes and records Probe verification from the replayed Probe inputs, target, command, and output.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result that copies, trusts, omits, or has an inconsistent Probe verification.
oracle.observable: The independent Probe-verification record in the Replay Result.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result independently verifies the Probe.
acceptance.when: When a Replay Result is successful.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the replay unit fixture with a successful receipt whose independently recomputed Probe verification is absent or inconsistent; success must be rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain replay result to independently reconstruct and verify the Probe before reporting success, rejecting an absent or inconsistent verification.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay results gain independent Probe-verification data; existing receipts remain readable but cannot establish SM-5 success when that data is absent.

slice_hint.state_transition: A replay moves from unestablished Probe verification to an independently reconstructed matching verification, or is rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful Replay Result contains an independent Probe verification bound to the executed replay; an absent, copied, or mismatched verification fails.

acceptance.given: Rollback has run for applicable route transitions of a non-empty Consumer Manifest.

oracle.expected: Every manifest entry has a post-rollback observation matching its Prior Behavior Baseline route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A Consumer Manifest entry without a post-rollback baseline observation.
A post-rollback observation that does not match the Prior Behavior Baseline.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer post-rollback baseline observations and their manifest coverage result.

acceptance.then: Every Consumer Manifest entry observes the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.
acceptance.when: After rollback of applicable route transitions.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the replay unit fixture with a non-empty Consumer Manifest whose entry lacks, or mismatches, its post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; aggregate success must be rejected.

affected_subjects: Post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for non-empty Consumer Manifest entries
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain replay result to record and compare a post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for every entry of a non-empty Consumer Manifest.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay results gain per-Consumer rollback-baseline observations; existing receipts remain readable but incomplete manifest coverage cannot satisfy SM-4.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each Consumer changes from a post-rollback baseline observation being due to having a recorded observation matching its Prior Behavior Baseline.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The non-empty Consumer Manifest has a matching post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for every entry; any missing or mismatched observation fails.

acceptance.given: The FR-10 enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable flow executes for an applicable Consumer.

oracle.expected: The Consumer enable operation is executed and completed through its real repository call surface.
forbidden: An enable completion represented only by a simulated, indirect, or nonexistent call surface.
oracle.observable: The Consumer-specific real-call-surface enable invocation and completion record.

acceptance.then: The applicable Consumer completes enable through a real call surface.
acceptance.when: When the FR-10 enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable flow is executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the replay unit fixture with an applicable Consumer whose enable record resolves to a simulated, indirect, or absent call surface; completed enable must be rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain replay result to accept enable only when each applicable Consumer's real repository call surface actually completes it, and bind the completion record to that surface.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay results gain real-call-surface provenance for enable; existing receipts remain readable but cannot establish FR-10 enable completion without that provenance.

slice_hint.state_transition: An applicable Consumer changes from not enabled to enabled only after its real call surface records completed enable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every applicable Consumer has completed enable bound to a real repository call surface; a simulated, indirect, or absent surface fails.

acceptance.given: An adversarial target case is submitted to the Toolchain evaluator.

oracle.expected: The evaluator returns a rejection verdict for the adversarial target case.
forbidden: A successful evaluation verdict for the adversarial target case.
oracle.observable: The evaluator verdict and rejection diagnostic for the adversarial target case.

acceptance.then: The adversarial target case is rejected.
acceptance.when: When an adversarial target case is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the adversarial-target replay fixture and observe its expected rejection; a success verdict invalidates the RED observation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain evaluator to emit a rejection verdict and target diagnostic for an adversarial target case, preventing it from being published as success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The evaluator gains an adversarial-target rejection path while valid-target success-result formats remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: An adversarial target case submitted for evaluation transitions to an explicit rejected verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The adversarial-target fixture deterministically produces rejection and never a successful evaluation verdict.
